Addressed to: BST260 Teaching Team, Fall 2026

Project overview

For my final project, I plan to write two vignettes using two different datasets. The first will describe firearm law records from the RAND database. The second will describe firearm mortality rates from the CDC. I will analyze each dataset separately and focus on patterns in the data.

#Topic 1 :

Research question: Do the proportions of restrictive and permissive firearm law records differ across law classes in the RAND dataset?

  • Unit of analysis: One firearm law record.
  • Population: Firearm law records included in the RAND database.
  • Exposure: Law.Class; Effective.Date.Year will be used to describe changes over time.
  • Outcome: Effect, a categorical variable that identifies a record as restrictive or permissive.
  • Missing data: I will exclude records missing Law.Class or Effect from the proportion comparisons. I will exclude records missing Effective.Date.Year from the time trend analysis.
  • Confounders: I will not adjust for confounders because this is a descriptive analysis and will not estimate the causal effect of laws.

Topic 2: Firearm mortality by state and year

Research question: How did firearm death rates vary across states and over time from 2014 through 2024?

  • Unit of analysis: One location in one year.
  • Population: Locations included in the dataset from 2014 through 2024.
  • Exposure: Year and location, used to describe differences over time and across locations.
  • Outcome: Death.Rate, a continuous variable.
  • Missing data: I will check for missing values and exclude records missing the year, location, or death rate from the relevant analyses.
  • Confounders: I will not adjust for confounders because this analysis will describe patterns and will not try to explain their causes.
